mathematical_meanings: Left image: The trace is the graph of a periodic function whose marked points indicate a trough and a peak. Right image: The line is the graph of a periodic function repeating the same heights and depths across the x-axis.
Rationales: In both images the feature traces a repeating function graph. The cyan wave with marked extrema at (−π/2, 2.4) and (3π/2, 13). The blue oscillation of repeated peaks near y = 2.
